channel.title: verify402 — notes from before the signature
channel.description: Scope, receipts, and field notes from building a pre-signing gate for agent payments.

item.title: What a pre-signing gate can check — and what it can't
item.description: The checklist a gate can run on an agent payment or approval, and the things it must say it does not know.

item.title: A receipt is not a guarantee. It's a falsifiable record.
item.description: What a preflight receipt proves, what it does not, and why intent binding matters more than a green icon.

item.title: Three payment intents your agent should never sign unchecked
item.description: An unlimited approval, an x402 offer that does not match the resource, and a swap with no floor. The signature is valid; the intent is not.
